blocks.text: PHILADEPHIA — Yo, Adrian! LeBron did it! He took the 76ers to the movies. LeBron James organized a Sixers movie night Friday, treating the team to a private screening of ” I Play Rocky,” Peter Farrelly’s comedic, crowd-pleasing tale about the making of “Rocky.” The 76ers posted photos on social media of James and some of his teammates — including Jaylen Brown, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Labaron Philon Jr., Jabari Walker, Tacko Fall and Adem Bona — enjoying the film that celebrates the making of the film almost exactly 50 years since Sylvester Stallone’s breakthrough boxing classic first arrived in theaters.
